query: WITH changed AS (INSERT INTO tool_policies(endpoint_id,source_id,upstream_name,action) SELECT $1,source_id,name,$4 FROM unnest($2::uuid[],$3::text[]) targets(source_id,name) ON CONFLICT(endpoint_id,source_id,upstream_name) DO UPDATE SET action=EXCLUDED.action WHERE tool_policies.action IS DISTINCT FROM EXCLUDED.action RETURNING source_id,upstream_name) INSERT INTO control_changes(request_id,workspace_id,kind,item,action) SELECT $5,$1,'policy',t.path,$4 FROM changed c JOIN tools t ON t.source_id=c.source_id AND t.upstream_name=c.upstream_name
